topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I found out today that the tree I planted as a child is gone. It’s hard to process, but I’m sorting through the memories. That tree was more than just a plant; it was a marker of time, a silent witness to my growth. I remember the day we put it in the ground, the soil sticky between my fingers, the smell of bark and earth. Now, a new patch of grass lies where it used to stand. I’ll visit the spot, perhaps plant something new, carry forward the legacy in a different form. Life moves on, and so will I.
